issue.title: Flaky test_run_noninteractive_timeout_kills_process_group: empty child stdout under full parallel lane
issue.description:
tests/test_noninteractive_subprocess.py::test_run_noninteractive_timeout_kills_process_group failed under an escalated full just check (workspace sase_19, 2026-08-16, 6 xdist workers, 31161 items) with:

  IndexError: list index out of range
  at `child_pgid = int(output.strip().splitlines()[0])`

The test runs `python -c "import os, time; print(os.getpgrp(), flush=True); time.sleep(30)"` through `run_noninteractive(..., timeout=0.2)` and expects TimeoutExpired.output to contain the child's process-group id. Under the full parallel lane the captured output was empty, so splitlines()[0] raised. The timeout itself did fire (TimeoutExpired was raised).

This session did not touch `run_noninteractive` or that test file — it only added reserved `lease(...)` RUNNING-field labels. Isolated rerun of the session's own tests passed (38 passed).

SCOPE: reproduce under a contended full parallel lane, then either make the helper reliably capture the first flushed line before killing the group, or stop asserting on stdout that can be lost when the 0.2s budget expires before the child prints.
